supporting_observations.claim: At 13:49 UTC, sara.ali initiated an RDP connection from WS-SALI-01 to FILE-COP-01, and FILE-COP-01 recorded a successful interactive logon for sara.ali from that workstation.

The available records do not establish who created ext.rwong, the account's group membership or privileges, or whether the account was used; therefore they do not establish whether the alerted account creation was authorized.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records do not include domain-controller account-creation or group-membership audit events, or directory attributes for ext.rwong.
The endpoint and proxy records supplied do not link sara.ali or another actor to the creation of ext.rwong.
claims_not_established: Who created ext.rwong and from which host or session.
Whether ext.rwong was added only to Contractors or granted any additional group membership or privileges.
Whether the account's creation had an approved request or business purpose.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve domain-controller security and directory audit events around 13:42 UTC, including account creation and group-membership changes, with the actor, source host, and logon/session details.
Check ext.rwong's current and historical group memberships, privilege assignments, enabled status, and creation attributes.
Verify the help-desk request or ticket authorizing the temporary account and its intended expiry.
unrelated_findings: Separate review: sara.ali initiated RDP from WS-SALI-01 to FILE-COP-01 and logged on interactively. This differs from the stated practice that remote administration is done only from WS-PBECKER-01, but the records do not connect this session to ext.rwong's creation. Records: T108-00013, T108-00019, T108-00020.
